key_rules: 1 full turn = 2 half turns = 4 quarter turns.
1 quarter turn = 90°; 1 half turn = 180°; 1 full turn = 360°.
Acute < 90°; right = 90°; obtuse is between 90° and 180°; straight = 180°.
